title: Zesty Smoky Venezuelan Pappardelle Pasta
description: A spicy, smoky, crispy pasta perfect for a brunch‑mood meal, packed with high‑protein turkey and feta for a satisfying bite.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium‑high heat.
Add the ground turkey, season with salt and pepper, and cook until browned and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Push the turkey to one side, add the sliced bell pepper and onion, and sauté until softened, about 3–4 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic, smoked paprika, and chipotle powder, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Meanwhile, bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle for 2 minutes less than the package instructions to keep it al dente.
Drain the pasta and reserve 1/4 cup of pasta water, then add it to the skillet with the turkey and vegetables.
Toss in the crumbled feta, lime zest, lime juice, and chopped cilantro, stirring until the cheese melts slightly.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a serving bowl, top with roasted chickpeas for a crispy finish, and garnish with extra cilantro if desired.
Serve immediately for a zesty, smoky, brunch‑mood high‑protein dish.
